facts_of_case: Wife's appeal against the judgment of Additional District Judge, Barnala, dated 22-10-1991, who had allowed the petition filed by her husband for dissolution of marriage and granted a decree of divorce. Husband had filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act against wife on 16-7-1984 and it was decreed on 28-4-1987. Wife did not resume cohabitation in spite of the decree.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that there has been no resumption of cohabitation for a period of more than one year.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that there has been no resumption of cohabitation for a period of more than one year.

legal_principles.principle: A decree for restitution of conjugal rights does not automatically bar a subsequent petition for divorce.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a decree for restitution of conjugal rights does not automatically bar a subsequent petition for divorce.

outcome.final_order: A decree for divorce was granted to the husband.

keywords: Latin maxim: 'Nemo dat quod non habet'
